text.en:
The national road from Barangay San Vicente, Municipality of Cabiao up to the boundary of San
Isidro, Nueva Ecija, traversing the jurisdiction of the Municipality of Cabiao in the same province, is hereby
named the General Ismael D. Lapus National Highway.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
